microglia, which are activated by the trauma of probe implantation and by the release of endogenous mediators, produce cytokines in the brain.
microglia are the main source of IL-1 and a major source of IL-6 in the injured brain.

microglia are a major cellular source of proinflammatory cytokines in brain trauma and that these cells can respond to injury within a few hours of the insult.
